haiku.text:
`gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus` reports CLEAN, so I merge. The ruleset-precheck copilot_code_review blocker is a known false positive (#3335); I do not call `requestReviews` or add reviewers to work around it.

```bash
gh pr merge 42 --squash --delete-branch
```
